rows.notes: The study is a narrative literature review (title, abstract and Section 1 state it is a review of water leak detection methods; Author Contributions and 'Data Availability: Not applicable' confirm no own data). It reports no own experiment, survey, field data or validated model runs. All results on machine learning anomaly detection (SVM, KNN, ANN, CNN, Kalman filtering) and flow/pressure sensing are cited from other work (e.g. refs 83-98), which do not count. It therefore provides no own evidence on flow metering with predictive analytics preventing water waste or infrastructure damage. Q1 is no, so Q2-Q9 are no.
